card_config.value: Add this card to your hand, or if you have the required energy, perform Raid with it.

card_set: Booster Pack BLEACH ThousandYear Blood War Vol.2 [UEX01BT]
card_text:
【Raid】 <Kenpachi Zaraki> Switch to active. May move to the front line.
This character is not affected by BP-reducing abilities.
【Impact (1)】 (When this character attacks and wins a battle, deal 1 damage to your opponent.)
If the base card of this Raided character has 4 or more required energy, this character gains all abilities listed below.
・If this character leaves the field due to one of your opponent's abilities or battle, you may place one card from your hand into your sideline instead. If you do, place the top card from this Raided character into your sideline.
・[When Played] This character gains 1000 BP and 【Damage (2)】 until the end of the turn.

regulations.title: One Battle Rule BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War
